summary: Feed s092_single is degraded: 4.2% of frames (113/2711) exceed IDS 1518-byte MTU (up to 8058 bytes) and are dropped by NIC, creating detection blind spot. All other visibility checks healthy.

findings.root_cause: Network carries jumbo frames up to 8058 bytes but IDS 1G port is limited to 1518 bytes and packet broker forwards them unchanged; NIC drops oversize frames as invalid.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS silently drops 4.2% of traffic, losing full-payload inspection for those flows. Attacks or data exfiltration using large frames will be missed, reducing detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: IDS needs_full_payload=true so slicing would break detection. Enabling jumbo-frame support (~9000B MTU) on IDS port (and broker egress) preserves complete payload while preventing NIC drops.
